title: Not as Described or Defective Merchandise/Services
claim_summary: The cardholder asserts the goods or services did not match the merchant's description, or arrived damaged or defective.

requirements.description: A detailed rebuttal showing what was delivered matched its description and was not defective, addressing each of the cardholder's specific claims (a third-party opinion strengthens it).
Proof the cardholder did not attempt to return, exchange, or refuse delivery of the product.
If applicable, proof the cardholder agreed to a repaired or replacement product and that it was delivered and received.
If a refund was already issued, documentation showing the cardholder's account was credited.
If resolved directly with the cardholder, written correspondence showing they no longer wish to dispute the charge.

meta.note: Liability cannot be deflected to the manufacturer, and this code overrides the merchant's refund policy. Summarized from a reputable secondary source aligned with Visa merchant dispute guidelines; cross-check against current Visa Core Rules or your acquirer before production use.
